label: Huawei NetEngine 8000 M8 AC (2x CR8DE1KB00M1, 1x CR8DE4NB00M1, 1x CR8DE8YF0025, 2x CR5D00LAXF91)
description: Huawei NetEngine 8000 M8 AC 3U service router chassis, modelled as the build the vendor states in its own typical-configuration row: all six AC service slots filled with 2x CR8DE1KB00M1 400GE QSFP-DD, 1x CR8DE4NB00M1 100GE/50GE QSFP28, 1x CR8DE8YF0025 25GE/10GE SFP28 and 2x CR5D00LAXF91 10GE/GE SFP+ - 2x 400G QSFP-DD, 4x 100G QSFP28, 8x 25G SFP28 and 20x 10G SFP+, 34 ports in all. 4.8 Tbit/s switching with IPU-2T4-A forwarding units, 774.3 W typical on the AC chassis, 19 kg fully configured, 132.6 x 442 x 220 mm.
notes: Port census is a stated build, not a fixed chassis figure: the NetEngine 8000 M8 has no fixed-interface slot, so every cableable port arrives on a PIC and an empty chassis has none. Slot table, Hardware Description V800R024C10SPC500 Table 1-14 (M8): PIC DC: 1-8, AC: 2, 4-8 | IPU 9,10 | PIU DC: 11,12, AC: 1,3 | FAN 13 - i.e. 8 service slots on the DC chassis and 6 on the AC one, and no fixed-interface row (contrast the M4, whose slot 5 is "Fixed interface"). The build modelled here is Huawei's own measurement configuration, quoted verbatim from the datasheet AC specification table: "[IPU-2T4-A/IPU-2T4-E-B]2*CR8DE1KB00M1(1*400GE)+1*CR8DE4NB00M1(4*100GE)+1*CR8DE8YF0025(8*25GE)+2*CR5D00LAXF91(10*10GE)=774.3 W". Six cards, six AC service slots - the configuration fills every slot the AC chassis has, so no slot is left silently empty and no card-to-slot assignment has to be invented. That is why this entry is the AC variant. The same table on the DC chassis (Table 1-19/1-20, CR8BM8BKPDC2) states a seven-card build for its eight service slots - "2*CR8DE1KB00M1+1*CR8DE4NB00M1+1*CR8DE8YF0025+2*CR5D00LAXF91+1*CR5D00EAGF95(10*GE)=739.1 W" - which leaves one slot empty and is a different population; it is recorded here rather than folded into this port list. Card port counts and sockets, from the vendor's own card names on the interface-card page: CR8DE1KB00M1 "1-Port 400GBase-QSFP-DD Single-layer Physical Interface Card(PIC)"; CR8DE4NB00M1 "4-Port 100GBase/50GBase-QSFP28 Physical Interface Card(PIC)"; CR8DE8YF0025 "8-Port 25GE(SFP28)/10GE(SFP+) MACsec Physical Interface Card (PIC)"; CR5D00LAXF91 "03033BLN: 10-Port 10GE/GE LAN/WAN-SFP+ MACsec Physical Interface Card(PIC)". So 2 x 400GE QSFP-DD, 4 x 100GE/50GE QSFP28, 8 x 25GE/10GE SFP28 and 20 x 10GE/GE SFP+ = 34 ports. Port names are flat (400ge0 .. 10ge33) because the vendor does not publish which card sits in which PIC slot for this configuration; NetEngine 8000 names ports slot/subcard/port, so slot-numbered names here would assert an ordering the datasheet never prints. Chassis figures, AC table: 132.6 x 442 x 220 mm (3U), 19 kg fully configured, 11 slots of which 6 are service board slots, switching capacity 4.8 Tbit/s with IPU-2T4-A (2.4 Tbit/s with IPU-1T2-AU), MTBF 112.71 years, MTTR 0.5 h, airflow left to right, < 72 dB(A), -20 to +55 C long term, 2 power modules 1+1, redundant IPUs 1:1, fans 1+1. Deliberately absent: any management/OAM port (ETH/OAM, console, TOD and alarm ports are listed in the hardware description but not with a cableable count on either page read); PoE (a carrier router, none published); the per-rate maxima on the AC chassis (120 physical ports, 3 x 400GE, 18 x 100GE, 48 x 25GE, 60 x 10GE, 60 x GE with IPU-2T4-A) - those are maxima over six fitted cards, not this build; and the IPU-1T2-AU reading of the same table (2*CR8DE2NB00M0(2*100GE)+1*CR5D00E4XM25(4*25GE)+2*CR5D00LAXF91(10*10GE)+1*CR5D00EAGF95(10*GE)=656.1 W), which is a second six-card build for the same chassis. Capabilities: CGN is why "nat" is declared and the datasheet's feature table ("DHCP Relay, DHCP Server", "BNG/BRAS (IPoE/PPPoE), NAT/CGN, IPsec, MACsec, service awareness (SA)") is why "dhcp-server" is; MPLS, SRv6, EVPN/VXLAN, FlexE, MACsec, IPsec and 1588v2/G.8275.1 are recorded here rather than declared, since no engine capability token covers them. Sources read 2026-11-17: https://e.huawei.com/marketingcloud/pep/asset/20000001/Material/e9dd06e260b64df683f6221fc8442cbf/M3T1A590N1140253824460255266/NetEngine%208000%20M8%20Universal%20Service%20Router%20Datasheet.pdf (canonical; AC and DC specification tables, stated configurations, maxima); https://support.huawei.com/enterprise/en/doc/EDOC1100465701/e4ccf4a0/netengine-8000-m8 (Hardware Description V800R024C10SPC500, slot table 1-14 and Tables 1-19/1-20, read with a crawler user-agent after a browser user-agent gets HTTP 403); https://support.huawei.com/enterprise/en/doc/EDOC1100465701/af1a855b/interface-card (every card part number with its port count and socket in the name); https://e.huawei.com/en/products/routers/ne8000 (per-model switching, forwarding, line-card-slot, power table).
